title: Rehabilitation after a hip fracture
also: rehab after hip replacement for a fracture
how to walk after a hip fracture
what: After hip surgery, the person is gradually taught to stand, walk and look after themselves. Sessions are led by a physical therapist or rehabilitation doctor.
why: After surgery for a hip fracture, to get walking again and avoid problems from lying in bed.
duration: sessions usually take 30 to 60 minutes, and recovery takes several weeks or months
tell_doctor: Which operation was done and what the surgeon allowed
How the person moved before the fracture

prepare.title: Clothing
prepare.text: Comfortable clothes and closed shoes with non-slip soles and no laces.

prepare.title: Support
prepare.text: A walker or crutches - the therapist will tell you which are needed.

prepare.title: Home
prepare.text: Remove rugs and cords from the floor, put in a night light and handrails in the bathroom.

steps: The therapist checks how you sit, stand and move your leg
You are taught how to get out of bed and sit down correctly
You practice walking with a walker or crutches
You do exercises for the leg and back muscles
You are taught to climb stairs and move safely at home
You are given exercises for every day
feel: At first walking is hard and frightening - this is normal
Your leg may ache after sessions
You get tired quickly in the first weeks
after: Do the exercises every day as you were shown
Follow the surgeon's limits - for example, no deep bending or crossing your legs
Do not walk without support until you are allowed
red_flags: Severe hip pain, the leg looks shorter or is turned outward - call your doctor
Swelling and pain in the calf
Sudden shortness of breath or chest pain - call your local emergency number
A fall with pain in the operated leg

faq.q: Will an older person walk again?
faq.a: Many return to walking with or without support. The sooner they start moving, the better the result.

faq.q: Can they stay in bed until it heals?
faq.a: Long bed rest is dangerous: bedsores, pneumonia and blood clots. People start getting up as early as the doctor allows.

reminders.text: Rehabilitation session today. Wear comfortable shoes and take your walker or crutches.
